bindings_rules.applies_to: verity_cba::triton_launch of batch_invariant._rms_norm_kernel (kernel name + constexprs pinned)
preconditions: kernel qualified name is the profile's `_rms_norm_kernel`
BLOCK_SIZE=1024, HAS_WEIGHT=True (profile pins)

input is bf16 [R, N] with unit column stride (row stride = the launch's input_row_stride, >= N: a column slice of a wider row is allowed), weight bf16 [N], output an unwritten allocation [R, N] (row stride = output_row_stride)
n_cols == N; eps is a static float; grid == (R,)
bindings_rules.evidence_domain: structural; numerics: RMSNormTriton_v1 (the same Triton kernel, W11 model)

bindings_rules.applies_to: verity_cba::triton_launch of batch_invariant.matmul_kernel_persistent (kernel name + constexprs pinned)
preconditions: kernel qualified name is the profile's `matmul_kernel_persistent`; source sha256 pinned

the active TargetProfile's capability has a REGISTERED GEMM specialization (verity_vllm.program.registry.gemm_targets: ada cc 8.9 with vLLM's tuned sm_89 table, ampere cc 8.0 default tiling only; anything else -> numerics_unregistered)

tiling = that target's launch geometry for (M, N, K) (GemmTarget.launch_config: the default 128/128/64, 8 warps, 3 stages, or the M-bucket row of the target's pinned tuned table); GROUP_SIZE_M 8, *_LARGE False, HAS_BIAS False, NUM_SMS = the active TargetProfile's num_sms (default 128)
a is bf16 [M, K] row-major (stride_am K, stride_ak 1); b is bf16 [K, N] with stride_bk 1, stride_bn K (= W[N,K].t())
c is an unwritten allocation [M, N] row-major; bias_ptr is None; M, N, K equal the shapes
bindings_rules.evidence_domain: structural; numerics: Gemm_v1{K,N} (the same Triton kernel; f32 accumulator over BLOCK_SIZE_K tiles)

bindings_rules.applies_to: vllm.unified_kv_cache_update(key, value, layer_name: str) -> Tensor

bindings_rules.applies_to: vllm.unified_attention_with_output(query, key, value, Tensor! output, layer_name: str, output_scale=None, output_block_scale=None, kv_cache_dummy_dep=None)
preconditions: the layer's OBSERVED attention implementation (instantiated `Attention.impl` class, backend, FA version, window, soft cap, alibi, sinks, kv dtype, batch_invariant_enabled) equals ATTN_PINS — derived from the model instance, never assumed
q [T, NH, D], k, v [T, KVH, D] bf16 (or flat rows with config D); NH % KVH == 0
output is an unwritten allocation of q's shape
layer_name is a static string owned by exactly one module

kv_cache_dummy_dep, if present, is this layer's pending write of the SAME k, v rows
assumed (op contract): causal attention over the history + this call's rows
bindings_rules.evidence_domain: structural; numerics: the vocabulary's attention kind per position (FA2 causal GQA)

bindings_rules.applies_to: aten.view / reshape / flatten / unit-step slice / permute / t / transpose of an unwritten allocation
preconditions: operand is an unwritten Alloc

view/reshape/flatten: leaf count is preserved; slice: step 1 (a sub-allocation of the same storage -- vLLM's MoE workspace carving `buf[:n].view(...)`); permute/t/transpose: the viewed type is the node's (an axis order over the same leaves -- vLLM's column-major FP8 group scales `torch.empty(K/G, M).permute(-1, -2)`)
bindings_rules.evidence_domain: structural (no gates)
